claim: OPENIA claims up to 2X F1 improvement over baselines in standalone and 3X in repository-level code generation using hidden-state probes.
stance_target: L2 occupancy: probe beats verbal/zero-shot readouts on code
quoted_support: OPENIA consistently outperforms baseline models, achieving higher accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-Scores with up to a 2X improvement in standalone code generation and a 3X enhancement in repository-specific scenarios.

breadth.confidence_families: hidden-state probe (last token, last layer; layer/token ablation RQ2, Fig. 5); LLM-CHECK; zero-shot LLM-as-judge (Sec. 4.3); no token-probability calibration
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: DeepSeek-Coder 1.3B/6.7B, Code Llama 7B/13B, Magicoder-7B (Sec. 4.2); o4-mini external judge
breadth.reasoning_models: o4-mini used only as external judge; reasoning setting not stated
breadth.label_source: benchmark test cases, 10 samples per task (Sec. 4.1); correct iff passes all tests (Sec. 3.1)
breadth.label_independence: benchmark-provided tests; not independent of benchmark-level leakage; not discussed
breadth.contamination_split: cross-benchmark MBPP-to-HumanEval and 9:1 task split (Sec. 4.3); no release-date control (searched: contamin)
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present (accuracy, precision, recall, F1 only; searched: Brier, ECE, calibrat)

claim: Baselines include in-house zero-shot LLM-as-judge and external o4-mini judge; probe is a 2-hidden-layer MLP (128, 64) on last-layer last-token state.
quoted_support: we adopt a zero-shot prompting strategy using the same prompt design, where the model is directly queried regarding the correctness of a given code snippet.

claim: Best-of-10 reranking by the probe improves average pass@1 by about 7%, and filtering raises passed-test rates 6%-86%.
quoted_support: By selecting the highest-scoring candidates predicted by OPENIA, the average pass@1 of the code LLMs across different settings improves by about 7%.

quoted_support: OPENIA’s F1-Score for predicting the correctness of Python code is 0.67, which is 12% lower than its average score.
